past.title: Doumar’s Cruise In | Oct. 28th
past.body:
(Weekly) Doumar's cruise-in Hosted by The Mustang and Ford Association of Virginia

Wednesday, October 28th | 6-8p

Located at Doumar's Cones & Barbecue, 1919 Monticello Ave., Norfolk.

Please join us for some cars at a weekly cruise-in every Wednesday night until it gets cold, all are invited! Bring your rides out and have some fun. They are open during these hours, so enjoy all the great eats and drinks they provide, including their amazing ice cream and handmade cones!

Be kind, clean up after yourselves, no excessive revving, and no burnouts and do not speed off when leaving their parking lot.

Hope to see you there!

past.title: Boost and Brunch VB | Oct 25th
past.body:
(Last Sun) Boost and Brunch VB

SUNDAY, October 25th | 8:30-11a

Located at Baja Coffee - 2041 Fisher Arch suite 100, Virginia Beach, VA 23456

Rev up your engines and fuel your passion for cars at our event! Whether you're a gearhead or just love seeing stunning rides, this is the place to be. Join us for a morning filled with:

Classic cars, exotic rides, and custom builds
Food & coffee to kickstart your day
Meet fellow car enthusiasts and share stories
Music, vibes, vendors, and more!

When: Every LAST Sunday of each month (April - October)
Time: 830am - 11am
Where: 2041 Fisher Arch suite 100, Virginia Beach, VA 23456

Bring your car, bring your friends, and let's make it a morning to remember. All cars, all makes, and all enthusiasts welcome!
See you there!

Sponsored by :
Skyline Sports Club of Virginia
Art of Imagery
Baja coffee co
RESPECT THE SPOT! NO SPEEDING, BURN OUTS, ETC.
Don't forget to tag us in your shots! @boostandbrunch on Instagram & follow for updates. Thanks for coming out and sharing your rides with everyone.

past.title: Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In | Oct 24th
past.body:
(Weekly) Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In Presented by Classic Cruisers Car Club

Saturday, October 24th | 4:30-8p

Located at Coastal Community Church, 101 Village Ave., Yorktown.

Mark your calendar to join us for our 1st Cruise-In. Cruz-Ins will be every Saturday from Apr 25 to Oct 24.

All years and types of vehicles are welcome – If you believe it’s cool, bring it in. We are asking for a $2.00 donation per vehicle. Please consider donating more – All proceeds go to charity. Vehicles are to be parked as directed by club personnel when necessary. No bicycles, skateboards, scooters, roller blades, or anything used in a manner that could injure people or damage vehicles are allowed in the participant parking area. Please do not touch vehicles without owners’ permission. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. No horseplay is allowed with vehicles at any time. (Such as burn-outs, engine revving, car hopping, loud radios or other disruptive actions). Alcoholic beverages, illegal drugs, and firearms are prohibited. There are to be NO SALES within the participant parking area EXCEPT for pre-approved items where the sale benefits charity. We are guests here. So PLEASE either take your trash with you or use the receptacles provided. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Trunk or Treat & Classics and Customs Cruise In | Oct. 24th
past.body:
Trunk or Treat & Classics and Customs Cruise In

Saturday, October 24th | 3p-6p

Bring the kids and join us for this Trunk or Treat event combined with the Classics and Customs Cruise In at Landstown Commons. This is a very popular and highly successful event.

Thanks to all of our hosting clubs:
7 Cities Camaro Club
Beachcombers Corvette Club
Virginia Chevy Lovers
Rollin' with the Knights

We will have community services onsite!

Participants are encouraged to bring lots of candy for the ghouls, goblins, princesses, and heroes working the lot!

DJVinlo with DVC Entertainment will be there spinning the Halloween tunes, Sponsors and Vendors on-site, along with 757 Auto Events and Sinclair Communications.

Car entry is from 3 PM till 4 PM! $3 charitable donation at entry. BRING LOTS OF CANDY OR GOODIES! Trunk or Treat is from 4 to 6 pm and no vehicles will be permitted to come or go during that time.

More Info

past.title: Rollin Legends Meet & Greet @ Bubba's 33 | Oct 18th
past.body:
(3rd Sun) Rollin Legends Meet & Greet @ Bubba's 33

Sunday, OCtober 18th | 4-6p

Located at Bubba's 33, 4120 Portsmouth Blvd., Chesapeake.

Calling all car enthusiasts! Whether you're cruising in a classic or showing off your custom ride, the ROLLIN LEGENDS MEET & GREET is the perfect place to connect with fellow gearheads. Come through, enjoy great food, and check out some amazing vehicles! What to Expect: Custom & Classic Cars; Good Vibes & New Friends; Delicious Eats at Bubba's 33; A Chill Hangout for Car Lovers. past.title: NK Cruisers Cruise In | Oct 16th
past.body:
[1st & 3rd fri] NK Cruisers Cruise In

Friday, October 16th | 6-9p

Located at Rosie's Lot 7, 10515 Colonial Downs Pkwy., New Kent.

NK Cruisers meet the 1st and 3rd Friday 6-9p or until the last person leaves (November-March). NK Cruisers, a local car enthusiast and cruise-in group bringing the car community together between Richmond and Williamsburg. The focus is New Kent, Charles City, and Lanexa but we welcome all folks from all areas. All years, makes, models, years, cars, truck, motorcycles, golf carts, boats, tractors, and trailered vehicles always welcome. Inclement weather cancels. For more information email: nkcruisers@gmail.com and NK Cruisers Facebook page for announcements and information. www.facebook.com/groups/277456353510653/

past.title: Cars and Coffee Chesapeake | Oct 10th
past.body:
[2nd sat] Cars and Coffee Chesapeake

Saturday, October 10th | 8a-11a

Located at Everbowl - 1244 Greenbrier Pkwy #570, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Team Ultraspeed and Everbowl are teaming up to bring you the best Cars and Coffee meets in the area! Come hangout and help us close out the 2025 Car Season. We are collecting non-perishable goods this month for the Foodbank of Southwestern VA. Give Thanks, Give Food. Help us drive out hunger! We are also still collecting new kids pajamas to support Pajama Jams. Pajama Jams collects these items throughout the year in preparation for their important Annual Holiday Pajama Drive for Hampton Roads. Please drop off your donations at the Red Ultraspeed tent, you can write it off on your taxes! We are now a 501(C)3! You won't want to miss this, so mark your calendars and we'll see you there! 

More info
